svg.title: Calculus on axes
svg.desc: Three graphs. A secant through two points of a curve shrinks onto the tangent while its slope counts down to the derivative, then the tangent slides along the curve. Riemann rectangles under a parabola split from 2 to 32 while their sum approaches the area, which fills in. A curve bends through the Taylor polynomials of cos x, hugging the cosine further out with each degree.
